notes.title: Update Contents & Fix Issues (2023.12.14)
notes.notes:
[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Revamped the tutorial. Now, tutorials appear in situations where explanations are needed.
[*]Adjusted the balance of monsters in Stage 1.
[*]Increased the healing amount during camping.
[*]Cards balance patch (8)
[*]Relics balance patch (4)
[/list]

[b]Fixed Issues[/b]
[list]
[*]Display more detailed information when forging cards at the blacksmith.
[*]Display information when obtaining cards or relics during events with choices.
[*]Implemented modifications to enhance the visibility of various UI elements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Contents & Fix Issues (2023.11.23)
notes.notes:
[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Now, you can experience the first battle of Stage 2 in the demo gameplay. 
Many users have shared the opinion that the demo gameplay feels too short.
We plan to continually adjust the limits of the demo gameplay 
to provide a better experience for you.

[*]Cards balance patch (4)
[*]Relics balance patch (2)
[/list]

[b]Fixed Issues[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the issue where the effects of the Double Shot skill were not properly reflected after use.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Contents & Fix Issues
notes.notes:
Updates
[list]
[*]You can now view the [b]battle logs[/b] in your deck. 
The battle logs display information about the skills used in the battle.
[*]Adjust the Probability of the same card appearing when replacing cards.
[*]Card and tutorial translations have been simplified, and the sentences have been clarified.
[*]Explanations of stat effects have been added to the tooltips for Relics, Cards, and Scrolls.
[/list]

Fixed Issues
[list]
[*]The tooltip information of your hand cards is dynamically updated to reflect the current battle situation
[*]Relics balance patch (3)
[/list]

notes.title: Update Contents & Fix Issues
notes.notes:
[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added 6 new events.
[*]Added [b]cursed chests[/b].
[*]Added a[b] blood shop[/b].
[*]Changed card tooltips to display values differently. 
    If the card's default value is different, mark the value with a ★ symbol.
[/list]

[h1]Fixed Issue[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed numerical representation errors of cards due to translation data issues.
[/list]
